1.

Our Lord Jesus has gone With victory from His grave, Not death shall be our lot, He gave life to us.

C.

The Lord, who died upon the cross, From death’s domain took captives.

2.

Who can accuse us? O hear, what joyful tidings: In Jesus’ death has vanished All that has separated us from God.

3.

Who then can accuse Him whom God has justified, And who can condemn Him who has believed Christ’s work?

4.

Now Christ has given ransom, He has completed His work. He has prepared help for us And laid the enemy low.
